title: Dropping outside a bunker due to abnormal conditions
question: If you take relief outside a bunker from an abnormal course condition in the bunker, what must you do according to the Rules?

choices.text: Drop outside the bunker without penalty
Drop outside the bunker and add one penalty stroke
Place the ball anywhere outside the bunker without penalty
You cannot take relief outside the bunker

explanation: If you take relief outside the bunker for abnormal course conditions, you must add a one-stroke penalty.
